headline.purpose: Functional page headings; library and preview headings use context-specific sizes.

body.purpose: Shared Chinese and English local UI stack.

result-title.purpose: Two-line titles in the bookmark list.

reading.purpose: Extracted page content with relaxed leading and a 72ch maximum measure.

label.purpose: Fields, preview tabs and quiet inline actions.

caption.purpose: Domains, filter chips and supporting metadata.

motion.name: drawer-enter
motion.purpose: Reading drawer translates from 24px to zero.

motion.name: facet-chevron
motion.purpose: Expandable facet chevrons rotate to 90 degrees.

motion.name: busy-spin
motion.purpose: Indeterminate busy indicator; never an estimated percentage.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Applied to all elements and pseudo-elements when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confirmed primary action, such as saving model settings or choosing an import file.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button">保存配置 · Save settings</button>
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 15px;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;border:0;background:var(--accent, #6541c7);color:var(--on-accent, #fff);}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.94);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Independent tests, retries and less prominent actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-secondary" type="button">测试连接 · Test connection</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 15px;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;border:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);background:var(--canvas, #fff);color:var(--ink, #242429);}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--inset, #f8f8fa);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48;}

components.name: Text Button
components.description: A quiet inline action that becomes underlined on hover.
components.css: .ds-text{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--accent, #6541c7);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;padding:5px 0;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-text:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px;}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-text:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.48;}

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Compact labeled controls for paging, theme switching and closing preview.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" type="button" aria-label="下一页 · Next page"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M19 12H5m7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Inset query field; focus belongs to the whole container.
components.html: Ctrl K
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--inset, #f8f8fa);border:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--muted, #65656f);font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--accent, #6541c7);outline:1px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);}.ds-search-input{min-width:0;width:100%;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #242429);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;caret-color:var(--accent, #6541c7);font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-search-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #65656f);}.ds-search-key{border:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 4px;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}@media(max-width:719px){.ds-search-key{display:none;}}

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: Purple selection on the quiet rail with a tabular collection count.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--rail, #f5f5f7);padding:10px;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-nav-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:100%;text-align:left;padding:9px 12px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:none;color:var(--muted, #65656f);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--rule, #dedee5);color:var(--ink, #242429);}.ds-nav-active{background:var(--soft, #eee8fb);color:var(--accent, #6541c7);font-weight:600;}.ds-nav-active:hover{background:var(--soft, #eee8fb);color:var(--accent, #6541c7);}.ds-nav-count{margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Removable active filter that wraps safely for long collection names.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;max-width:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere;padding:3px 8px;border:0;background:var(--soft, #eee8fb);color:var(--accent, #6541c7);border-radius:5px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6;cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-chip svg{flex-shrink:0;}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Model Settings Panel
components.description: An outlined channel panel with a visible configuration state; no raised card shadow.
components.html:
对话模型 · Chat model

已配置 · Configured

为对话和嵌入分别测试连接。
Test chat and embeddings independently.
components.css: .ds-panel{border:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);border-radius:12px;padding:24px;background:var(--canvas, #fff);color:var(--ink, #242429);font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-panel-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:20px;}.ds-panel-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0;}.ds-panel-status{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #65656f);}.ds-panel-hint{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:var(--muted, #65656f);margin:0 0 16px;}@media(max-width:1119px){.ds-panel{padding:22px;}}@media(max-width:719px){.ds-panel{padding:18px;}}

components.name: Selected Result Row
components.description: A ruled result with a two-line title and excerpt; selected title and surface use the purple roles.
components.css: .ds-result{display:flex;width:100%;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;padding:19px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #242429);cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-result:hover{background:var(--inset, #f8f8fa);}.ds-result-selected,.ds-result-selected:hover{background:var(--soft, #eee8fb);}.ds-site{flex-shrink:0;width:27px;height:27px;border:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);border-radius:6px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted, #65656f);background:var(--canvas, #fff);margin-top:1px;}.ds-result-copy{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1;}.ds-result-title{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;overflow-wrap:anywhere;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;}.ds-result-selected .ds-result-title{color:var(--accent, #6541c7);}.ds-result-summary{color:var(--muted, #65656f);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-result-meta{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted, #65656f);line-height:1.6;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;}.ds-result>svg{color:var(--muted, #65656f);flex-shrink:0;margin-top:7px;}.ds-result:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}@media(max-width:719px){.ds-result{gap:10px;padding:17px 14px;}.ds-result-title{font-size:14px;}.ds-result>svg{display:none;}}

components.name: Reading Preview Tabs
components.description: Underlined active tab on the reading surface; the React implementation provides arrow-key selection and tab-panel linkage.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;gap:22px;padding:0 30px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule, #dedee5);background:var(--inset, #f8f8fa);font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-tab{padding:12px 0;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;background:none;font-size:12px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--muted, #65656f);cursor:pointer;font-family:"Segoe UI","PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;}.ds-tab[aria-selected="true"]{border-bottom-color:var(--accent, #6541c7);color:var(--accent, #6541c7);font-weight:600;}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #6541c7);outline-offset:3px;}@media(max-width:719px){.ds-tabs{padding:0 24px;gap:20px;}}

narrative.overview:
Facetmark is a restrained search and reading workbench: paper-white surfaces, graphite text and a single purple accent keep a personal bookmark library readable. This is the user-confirmed replacement for the legacy sketch interface. The implemented React interface is the visual authority and is shared by the Tauri 2 desktop shell, Python distribution and Docker image.

The recurring signature is a ruled result list beside a quiet reading surface, with query and collection context retained while inspecting a page. Density supports repeated scanning; Chinese and English use the same locally available UI font stack. The system uses tonal separation, simple outlines and useful state changes rather than decorative illustration.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white and graphite foundations with purple for action, selection and focus.
Compact navigation and results paired with more generous reading rhythm.
Light and dark themes, bilingual labels and local CJK font fallbacks.
Responsive drawers preserve access to search, filters and reading.

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Use purple for primary actions, links, selected items and focus. Use graphite and muted neutrals for the collection itself; reserve danger color for failures.

rules.name: Reading Rhythm
rules.body: Keep result titles and excerpts compact while giving page text a relaxed line height. Allow Chinese text, long titles and URLs to wrap without forcing the workbench wider.

rules.name: Flat Surfaces
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with tone and thin rules. Modal depth comes from a scrim and stacking order, not card shadows.

dos: Do preserve query, filters, pagination and result context while opening and closing a reading preview.
Do use the same semantic color roles in light and dark themes.
Do keep Chinese and English labels readable with local CJK font fallbacks and text wrapping.
Do preserve visible focus, keyboard tab navigation and focus return when a drawer closes.
Do distinguish empty libraries, no matches, missing page text, loading and recoverable failures.
Do use synthetic data and a visible demo label for presentation captures.
donts: Don't reintroduce hand-drawn borders or candy-colored dashboard surfaces.
Don't turn collection rows into a grid of raised decorative cards.
Don't require remotely loaded fonts or imagery for the workbench to function.
Don't communicate selection, progress or failure through color alone.
Don't display an estimated progress percentage when only the active stage is known.
